# How Microsegmentation namespaces, tags and resource tags are configured and which are locked (zms.tags)
Also called: zms namespaces; zms custom tags; microsegmentation resource tags; cloud ml namespaces

Namespaces are where tags are created; admins can create custom namespaces, while ML and cloud namespaces are generated from the organization's data. [zms.tags:namespace-types]

**Locked objects.** Cloud and ML namespaces cannot be edited or deleted; custom namespaces can. [zms.tags:cloud-ml-namespaces-locked] Cloud and ML tags are autogenerated and cannot be manually configured, and tags within cloud and ML namespaces cannot be deleted; custom tags can be edited or deleted. [zms.tags:cloud-ml-tags-locked]

**Fields.** A custom tag has a Key, an optional Description and comma-separated Values, and can be assigned to resource groups. [zms.tags:custom-tag-fields] A tag added to a resource on the Resources VM page takes a Namespace, a Key and Value(s), and resource tags are used as criteria when configuring resource groups. [zms.tags:resource-tag-fields] The resource tag deletion page says individual resource tags can be deleted manually at any time from the Tags section in the resource drawer on the Resources VM page, and deleting one requires entering CONFIRM in the Delete Tag window. [zms.tags:resource-tag-delete] [gap:zms.tags:resource-tag-delete-scope]

**Prerequisite.** Configuring namespaces, tags and resource tags lists enabling policy enforcement for the organization as a prerequisite. [zms.tags:prereq-policy-enforcement]

**Related.** The Tag Management page is in [The Microsegmentation portal: Application Catalog, ML tag recommendations, tags and AppZones](kb:zms.portal) and resource groups that use tags in [What Microsegmentation resources, Kubernetes cluster resources and resource groups are, including ML recommendations](kb:zms.resources).

What to check:
1. Whether the namespace is custom, cloud or ML before trying to edit or delete a tag or namespace.

Not known (open gaps):
- Does the 'at any time' resource tag delete apply to tags in cloud and ML namespaces? [gap:zms.tags:resource-tag-delete-scope]: settled by lab-test
